rows.observation: Runtime risk: physical.lua:320 formats this string with tformat(eff.power). The target's 「降低 50%。」 has a lone % followed by a full-width character, which is not a valid conversion, so Lua 5.1 string.format raises invalid option and the effect description breaks. Separately, the source string only says "%d%% chances to encase your foes in iceblocks". The added 「造成伤害时」, 「3 回合」 and 「冰块吸收的伤害降低 50%」 have no support in this long_desc. Remove the unsupported additions, or escape it as %% and cite source evidence for them.
